- **Member Onboarding** – entire first-touch sequence missing (assessment, induction standards, PAR-Q, gym orientation, first class experience, goal-setting framework)
- **Member Checkins** – no systematic touchpoint cadence (30/60/90-day checks, retention signals, churn prediction triggers)

# Service Menu Build — Execution Play

• **Start with revenue reality, not wishful thinking**: Audit what you're *actually* selling now (group classes, 1-1 coaching, memberships tiers). Price each based on what members paid last month, not what feels right. This anchors you in market truth before you redesign.

• **Create two separate documents, same content**: Coaches need the margin story (what they earn per service, what's bundled vs. upsold). Members need the clarity story (what fits their goal, what progression looks like). Use identical pricing but frame differently—coaches see profit, members see value.

• **Build it as a decision tree, not a list**: Instead of "£50/month" floating on a page, structure it as "Want to get stronger? → Small group = £40/month. Want accountability? → 1-1 coaching = £120/month." This reduces choice paralysis and drives upsells naturally.

• **Get this live in 48 hours, imperfect**: Slap it on a Google Doc, share internally, get feedback from your top 3 coaches and 3 members. Perfectionism kills momentum. You'll spot gaps when people actually use it, not in planning meetings.

• **Use this as your sales tool immediately**: Every inquiry gets walked through this menu by phone/WhatsApp before they join. Track which option converts best. Your menu isn't done until you've refined it 3 times based on real conversation data.

**Churn spike in May (12.8%) and member quality collapse.** Your member base grew 121→170 (+40%) but Rev/member fell £139→£105 (last two months), the worst ratio on record. You're acquiring bodies, not paying members.

Either new cohort is on low-tier plans or payment failure rates are rising. Pull TeamUp data: are Oct joiners on intro/trial pricing? If so, enforce 3-month lock-in minimum and raise intro price £5–8/month.

- **Class fill analysis.** You have capacity headroom (170 members, likely 40–50 peak-time slots/week available). Identify 3 consistently quiet slots (likely off-peak, mid-week mornings or late evenings). Run 4-week flash promotion: "Full access + 2 guest passes" for members who book 6 classes in 30 days. Cost: nil if you're already staffed; upside: £200–300/month in add-on PT or retail if retention improves.

- **Retention lever.** May churn was 12.8%, Oct was 4.0%—volatility suggests onboarding or class experience issue in May. Sep-Oct should show +15 net members; you got +10. At 5% churn, you're losing ~8 members/month (170×0.05). Each member at £138/month = £1,104/month revenue loss. **One retention win (drop to 3% churn) = +£1,700/month revenue, zero acquisition cost.**
